title: Music City Luxury sleeps 12+ pool, hot tub, tennis
description:
Plenty of space for a fun gathering with LOTS of amenities to keep everyone busy!  Large 5+ bed/ 5 full & 3 half bath home will comfortably sleep 12+.  Guests will have the use of the entire space as well as the outdoor amenities.  The pool is open mid May-Sept. and hot tub is open all year.  Full tennis court doubles as a basketball court. Sauna & full bath are in pool house and outdoor kitchen features grill, sink, fridge and seating on deck overlooking the beautiful hills of TN.

Guest access
Please refrain from using garage.

You may park in the front drive or back drive by the tennis court.  There may be personal vehicles parked by tennis court.

Other things to note
No firearms, hunting or fireworks allowed. 

No parties allowed over the amount of guests stated in reservation without prior approval and consent of owner.

No more than 5 vehicles allowed on property.

Owners have a cat and dogs that will not be here during your listing but they do occasionally come inside, please be aware if you have allergies.
